name: Streamline Cleaning (Multiple Tracts)
summary: Removes spurious streamlines from each tract in a set of .tck files with length, loop (angle and QuickBundles) and scilpy outlier filtering, plus optional Purifibre refinement.
description: Applies filter_spurious_streamlines.sh independently to every .tck in the input tract set: optional Purifibre first pass, length filtering, loop filtering, scilpy outlier rejection and optional Purifibre final pass. If a step fails the pipeline continues from the last valid track. Use it to clean segmented bundles before tractometry; for a single tractogram use the single-track version.

inputs.description: Set of tracts, one .tck file per bundle.
Reference anatomical image passed to the scilpy steps.

outputs.description: Cleaned tracts, one .tck per input file with the original names.

parameters.description: Minimum streamline length; shorter streamlines are removed (0 if empty).
Maximum streamline length; longer streamlines are removed.
Maximum turning angle used for loop rejection.
QuickBundles distance threshold for loop filtering.
scilpy outlier rejection alpha (scilpy default 0.6; README recommends 0.3-0.4).
Skip the scilpy outlier rejection step.
Percentage of streamlines Purifibre removes in a final pass (empty to skip).
Number of threads for loop detection.
